title: JapanesePod101 — 家族の紹介 (Introducing Your Family)
description: From JapanesePod101's free beginner lesson series. Covers Japanese family vocabulary and the important distinction between terms used for one's own family (humbly: 父, 母, 兄, 姉) versus terms used for someone else's family (respectfully: お父さん, お母さん, お兄さん, お姉さん). Includes example dialogue.
